summary: The Integrity Commissioner investigated four complaints about Councillor Brad Bradford made under the Code of Conduct for Members of Council (the “Code of Conduct”). The complaints alleged Councillor Bradford used constituent contact information from his office for election purposes in the 2023 mayoral by-election, without the constituents’ consent. The appended report of the inquiry under section 160 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 considers whether Councillor Bradford violated: Article 5 (Confidential Information) Article 7 (Election Campaign Work) Based on the evidence referenced in the report, the Integrity Commissioner found: Councillor Bradford’s conduct violated Articles 5 and 7.
decided: City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the findings that Councillor Brad Bradford has violated Articles 5 and 7 of the Code of Conduct. 2. City Council reprimand Councillor Brad Bradford.

text: The Integrity Commissioner investigated four complaints about Councillor Brad Bradford made under the Code of Conduct for Members of Council (the “Code of Conduct”). The complaints alleged Councillor Bradford used constituent contact information from his office for election purposes in the 2023 mayoral by-election, without the constituents’ consent. The appended report of the inquiry under section 160 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 considers whether Councillor Bradford violated: Article 5 (Confidential Information) Article 7 (Election Campaign Work) Based on the evidence referenced in the report, the Integrity Commissioner found: Councillor Bradford’s conduct violated Articles 5 and 7.

City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the findings that Councillor Brad Bradford has violated Articles 5 and 7 of the Code of Conduct. 2. City Council reprimand Councillor Brad Bradford.
